title: Red Fort
scope: Delhi’s standing Red Fort exterior and principal Mughal monuments: the red sandstone wall circuit and barbicans, Lahori and Delhi Gates, covered bazaar, drum house and audience hall, white marble eastern palace pavilions, the Pearl Mosque and Shahi Burj.
limitations: Standing exterior interpretation. Wall top levels, intervals between smaller bastions, later repairs, roof and arcade sections, and some local ground contacts are approximate.

The map and period photograph control historic architectural form. A selection of surviving Mughal buildings is represented. Later barracks, interiors, archaeology, moat excavation, and the adjacent Salimgarh Fort are outside the model.
Pale marble and red sandstone follow the official descriptions. The archived plan predates present changes and is used only for corroborating the surviving plan.
